name: Agnel Salve
title: AI Engineer | Data Engineer | LLM Systems & Verification
summary: AI and data engineer with 3+ years building pipelines whose numbers go straight to executives, now focused on LLM systems you can verify. Founder of Groundline Brief, where a second model fact-checks every sentence the first one writes.
skills: LLMs, RAG, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP servers, multi-agent systems, LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, Transformers (GPT, T5, BERT), Hugging Face, Ollama, Pinecone, ChromaDB, n8n, Claude Code

Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hive, Airflow, Snowflake, Redshift, Talend, Dask, ETL/ELT, CI/CD
PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, Pandas, NumPy, anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, NLP, YOLOv8, OpenCV

AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift, SageMaker, Lambda, EC2, RDS), Azure (Data Factory, Synapse, AML, Functions, ADLS Gen2), GCP Cloud Run, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, Power BI, Tableau, Datadog, Git

bullets: Owned claims fraud detection end to end after payout-stage leakage went undetected: trained XGBoost with SMOTE rebalancing and TF-IDF over adjuster notes, engineering claim-to-premium and report-delay signals to reach 92% ROC-AUC and 85% precision.
Rebuilt ML feature pipelines across 15+ on-prem sources as parameterized CTEs in Python and MS SQL with automated refreshes, cutting runtime 70% and making training and scoring datasets reproducible.
Architected the firm's first cloud ML data platform on AWS (S3, Glue, Redshift), designing multi-source connectors and orchestration that moved data freshness from T+2 to near real time.

Served as senior technical owner of the ML function without a dedicated MLOps team: defined drift and threshold reviews with claims operations, documented model assumptions and retraining cadence, and set review standards.

Stabilized 1 TB+ daily distributed workloads on Hadoop, Spark and Kafka by tuning job configurations, reworking partitioning and introducing CI/CD through Azure DevOps, improving pipeline stability 30%.
Engineered real-time streaming feature computation with Kafka, Spark Streaming and HiveQL serving views, closing a one-day reporting lag and processing metrics 45% faster for 200+ business users.
Standardized 50+ reusable metric definitions in SQL and HiveQL, an early feature-store pattern that cut downstream query time 40% and eliminated duplicate logic across domains.

Led the 5G infrastructure analytics workstream as delivery point of contact: modeled source data, built business KPIs in Python and HQL, shipped 2 production use cases and ran user acceptance testing.

projects.name: Groundline Brief, founder
projects.stack: n8n, Google Gemini (3 models), Python, Streamlit
bullets: Built a multi-model LLM pipeline that writes weekly competitor briefs and sends every claim to a different checker model; unsupported claims are removed and logged, and briefs under 85% grounded are flagged for human review.

Ingested 496 items from 17 feeds (news, Reddit, arXiv, Hacker News), validated and de-duplicated them to 294 records, and added an LLM relevance gate that rejected 49 of 66 off-topic results in one competitor run.

Computed every number in code rather than by the model, reaching 97% groundedness on a live brief at $0.089 per run; load-tested from 1 to 2,000 requests and validated with 3 product-marketing user tests.
